vi: Triển khai service registration/discovery qua Consul: instance tự ghi địa chỉ vào registry (PUT /v1/agent/service/register), consumer discovery theo tên service (GET /v1/health/service/:name), và deregister lúc shutdown để tránh stale data.
Thiết kế health check định kỳ để loại instance chết khỏi catalog: endpoint health join trạng thái check với catalog, chỉ trả instance 'passing' để consumer load-balance an toàn.
So sánh Client-Side vs Server-Side Discovery: client-side dễ control LB nhưng Language Lock-in, server-side qua LB/mesh sidecar đa ngôn ngữ hơn nhưng vận hành phức tạp.
Chọn instance ID riêng biệt khác service name để deregister chính xác một instance cụ thể thay vì xoá toàn bộ service, tối ưu chi phí khi scale.
Xử lý stale data: instance bị kill trước deregister sinh lỗi connection refused tới lúc health check tiếp theo; cần graceful shutdown + short interval + Circuit Breaker + Retry ở client.
en: Implement service registration/discovery with Consul: instances register their address (PUT /v1/agent/service/register), consumers discover by service name (GET /v1/health/service/:name), and deregister on shutdown to prevent stale data.
Design periodic health checks to remove dead instances from catalog: the health endpoint joins check state with catalog, returning only 'passing' instances for safe client-side load balancing.
Compare Client-Side vs Server-Side Discovery: client-side gives LB control but risks Language Lock-in; server-side via LB/mesh sidecar is more polyglot but adds orchestration complexity.
Use separate instance IDs distinct from service name to deregister the exact instance rather than the entire service, optimizing costs at scale.
Handle stale data: instances killed before deregister cause connection refused errors until the next health check; requires graceful shutdown, short intervals, Circuit Breaker, and Retry logic.
